SpecificationChanges.Before:
Number of qualified leads from Conversions API (CAPI) attributed to the target company. Note: Applicable only from API versions 202603 and later.

Documented type: long
SpecificationChanges.After:
Number of qualified-lead conversions attributed to your ads from members of the target company within the lookback window. Includes conversion types QUALIFIED_LEAD, MARKETING_QUALIFIED_LEAD, and SALES_QUALIFIED_LEAD, regardless of how they are sent (for example, through the Conversions API (CAPI)). Conversion events are counted, not unique leads: a lead reported to more than one of these conversion rules (for example, as both an MQL and an SQL) is counted once per rule. Returns 0 when seniority or jobFunction is specified. Note: Applicable only from API versions 202603 and later.

Documented type: long

SpecificationChanges.After:
Number of qualified-lead conversions attributed to your ads from members of the target company within the lookback window. Includes conversion types QUALIFIED_LEAD, MARKETING_QUALIFIED_LEAD, and SALES_QUALIFIED_LEAD, regardless of how they are sent (for example, through the Conversions API (CAPI)). Conversion events are counted, not unique leads: a lead reported to more than one of these conversion rules (for example, as both an MQL and an SQL) is counted once per rule. Returns 0 when seniority or jobFunction is specified. Note: Applicable only from API versions 202603 and later.

Documented type: long
